text:
Anika Rao: Quick preflight — marketplace launch dry run scheduled Fri. Need final confirmation on H200 thermal profile, Gaudi power policy, and MI300 quant kernel. Who has the latest perf deltas?
Benji Cole: I have perf diffs for H200 vs H100 on the 2.1 model family. H200 shows +12% throughput at batch=8 but spikes under 95C.
Samir Das: thx. spike = thermal clamp or driver bug?
Benji Cole: looks thermal at first glance. NVIDIA_Rep_Jess ran fw v1.2.5 which reduced clock slightly. logs in the gist: https://redwood.tools/s/thermals-h200-3
Riley Wong: CI harness flagged Gaudi soft-reset on long-run (3h) when KV cache warmed. Gaudi_Rep_Vik, any hints?
Gaudi_Rep_Vik: we pushed kernel patch gaudi-k-3.2.1 addressing a reset when `kv.size>8gb`. recommend `gaudi-runtime:2026-04-02-rc1`. Use `--power=balanced` for sustained load.
AMD_Rep_Lena: MI300 images include quant kernels but watch for small accuracy drift on float->int8 for some LLM ops. we added evaluator scripts to the repo.
Anika Rao: important: marketing wants a single compatibility badge. Ops prefers per-SKU notes. Can we agree on short blurb? suggested: "Verified on Redwood Dedicated with H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi (see compatibility matrix)"
NVIDIA_Rep_Jess: fine with that wording, just ensure we call out H200 >4k token caution.
Benji Cole: agree. add a footnote: "High-token workloads may use fallback lane for latency stability."
Samir Das: Deploy-Bot posted a staging image: `registry.redwood.io/marketplace/multi-vendor-launch:2026-04-08-rc2`. We'll run smoke today.
Deploy-Bot: staging image pushed. tag=multi-vendor-launch:2026-04-08-rc2, digest=sha256:abc123. smoke scheduled in 30m.
Riley Wong: lab booking: H200 cluster Fri 07:00 PST, Gaudi racks Fri 08:00 PST, MI300 bench Fri 09:30 PST. Calendar invites sent.
Anika Rao: thanks Riley. Ops ask: can vendors reserve 20 mins before their rack tests to apply firmware? avoids mid-run surprises.
Gaudi_Rep_Vik: yes — we'll patch 06:40-07:00 PST and keep rollback image available.
NVIDIA_Rep_Jess: we'll patch 06:30-06:50 PST. note: H200 fallback kernel requires `nvidia-h200-runtime:1.5.0-rt`.
AMD_Rep_Lena: MI300 patching 07:10-07:25 PST. will post release notes.
Samir Das: checklist reminder: (1) KMS envelope test, (2) marketplace image tags verified, (3) SI account RBAC, (4) legal embargo badge. Who owns KMS?
Benji Cole: I'll take KMS. will create two temp keys and revoke after test.
Anika Rao: legal embargo note: "Partner SI verification only 6; not for press" legal to confirm. I'll loop in Legal if no objections.
NVIDIA_Rep_Jess: also request a short 10-min window after smoke to validate tail-latencies for 8k token samples. H200 showed tail spikes previously.
Riley Wong: scheduled: smoke (15m) -> tail tests (15m) -> perf (45m) -> soak (3h). total ~4h.
Gaudi_Rep_Vik: one more: Gaudi runtime rc includes thermal mitigation controls. set env `GAUDI_POWER=balanced` and `GAUDI_THERMAL_OVERRIDE=1` for tests.
Benji Cole: noted. will add to runbook.
Samir Das: can marketing get a sanitized perf snapshot post-run? they want conservative numbers for the marketplace tile.
Anika Rao: yes — ops will publish a sanitized summary. No vendor-identifiable logs.
AMD_Rep_Lena: on accuracy drift we mentioned earlier: we'll include a small eval table showing token-level diffs; flagging if >0.5% for review.
Deploy-Bot: smoke run completed. id=ci-25781, status=passed, logs=/ci/runs/25781/logs
Riley Wong: perf run starting now. posting any failures here.
NVIDIA_Rep_Jess: noted. I'll be on-call for H200 during perf. ping me if tail lat > 600ms.
Gaudi_Rep_Vik: I'll monitor Gaudi racks for resets and power draw anomalies.
Anika Rao: closing notes: after dry-run, ops and vendors align on final compatibility matrix and marketing gets the blurb. Thanks all.
Samir Das: thanks team, will file post-run notes and any follow-ups.
Riley Wong: posting CI links and preliminary charts in thread once available.
